description: Eberban number recovery: loose-fraction stops before a base introduced by TI JU.
grammar:
%rule text loose-fraction loose-base
%rule loose-base
  TI JU

%rule loose-digits
  {TI}
%conditions
  ¬$.following-tokens.parse(TI …) ∨ $.following-tokens.parse(loose-base …)

%rule loose-fraction
  JO [$d:loose-digits]
%conditions
  $d ∨ ¬$.following-tokens.parse(TI …) ∨ $.following-tokens.parse(loose-base …)
